mapper.select: SELECT s.participant_id, s.event_id, s.space_id, p.name, p.pin_temporary AS pin_change_required FROM participant_sessions s JOIN participants p ON p.space_id = s.space_id AND p.event_id = s.event_id AND p.id = s.participant_id JOIN events e ON e.id = s.event_id AND e.space_id = s.space_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR #{now} < ((e.end_date + 1 + #{daysAfterEnd})::timestamp AT TIME ZONE #{zone}))
